Pricing

The Stillroom Premium

Joining The Stillroom is free. Premium is for members who want to host and stand out.

Free

  • Your profile, and finding people in your city
  • City chat, and one-on-one messages with connections
  • Going to events (RSVP)
  • Forums, ideas and Clarity

Premium — ₹500 for 30 days

  • Host events in your city: coffee, walks, co-working, board games
  • A violet ✨ Premium tag, and a glow on your messages, events and posts
  • See who viewed your profile in the last 30 days

Pay with UPI, cards or netbanking through Razorpay. Premium lasts 30 days from payment. It does not renew automatically — you’ll never be charged without paying yourself. Paying again before it ends adds 30 more days.

Prices include all charges. See our Refund & Cancellation policy and Terms.

Get Premium from your profile, or tap “Host event” in the app.
